signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.wrong: That email and password do not match an account.
signIn.failed: Signing in failed. Try again in a moment.
signIn.reasonAddToCart: Sign in to add this to your cart. You will come back to it.
signIn.reasonCart: Sign in to see your cart.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
signUp.failed: Creating the account failed. Try again in a moment.

account.title: Your account
account.note: Signed in. Reload the page: you stay signed in, and no token is stored anywhere a script can read.
account.detailsHint: Your email address is how you sign in, and cannot be changed here.
account.saveFailed: Your details could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
account.loadFailed: Your details could not be loaded.
account.passwordHint: Every other device signed in to this account will be signed out. This one stays.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
account.changed: Your password is changed. Other devices are signed out.
account.changeFailed: The password could not be changed. Try again in a moment.
account.myDataHint: One file with everything this shop holds about you: your details, addresses, orders, reviews, notices and more. Anything kept back - like the secrets of your sessions - is listed in it with the reason.
account.myDataPartial: Downloaded, but without {{services}}: that part of the shop did not answer. Try again in a moment for a complete file.
account.deleteHint: This cannot be undone. Your details, addresses, cart, saved products, notices and sessions are erased, and your email can be used for a new account. The shop keeps what it must for its books - your orders, payments and refunds - without your name, email, phone or address. Your reviews and questions stay, signed "a former customer".
account.deleteShopHint: A seller's shop closes with the account.
account.deleteConfirmBody: You are signed out everywhere, and nothing can bring the account back.
account.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted. Try again in a moment.
account.deleteRefused: Your account cannot be deleted yet:
account.deleteStaff: A staff account is not deleted from here. A moderator asks an administrator to revoke the role first.

deleteBlockers.OpenOrders: An order of yours is still on its way. Wait until it is delivered, or cancel it.
deleteBlockers.OpenReturns: A return is still in progress.
deleteBlockers.OpenSales: A sale of yours has not been delivered yet.
deleteBlockers.UnpaidEarnings: The shop still owes you earnings that have not been paid out.

addresses.title: Delivery addresses
addresses.none: You have no saved addresses yet.
addresses.loadFailed: Your addresses could not be loaded.
addresses.saveFailed: That change could not be saved.
addresses.countryHint: Two-letter code, such as VN or GB
addresses.dialogHint: Where your orders will be delivered. The country decides the tax at checkout.
addresses.subtitle: Where your orders can be delivered. The default is chosen for you at checkout.
addresses.noneHint: Add one now, or at checkout when you need it.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.hint: Type the email you sign in with. If it has an account, we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has an account, a link is on its way. It works once, for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder too.
forgot.failed: The link could not be requested. Try again in a moment.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: Every device signed in to this account will be signed out.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
reset.done: Your password has been changed, and every session has been ended.
reset.failed: The password could not be changed. Try again in a moment.

confirm.banner: Confirm your email address: we sent a link to {{email}}.
confirm.resent: A new link is on its way.
confirm.resendFailed: The link could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.done: Your email address is confirmed. Thank you.
confirm.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Sign in and ask for a new one from the banner at the top.

twoFactorStep.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactorStep.hint: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows for this shop.
twoFactorStep.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you kept when you set up two-factor sign-in. Each works once.
twoFactorStep.useApp: Use the code from your app
twoFactorStep.wrong: That code is not right, or was already used. Wait for the next one.
twoFactorStep.again: That took too long, or too many codes were wrong. Sign in again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.loadFailed: Two-factor sign-in could not be loaded.
twoFactor.staffMust: Your account can act for the shop, so it must use two-factor sign-in. Your staff pages open once it is on.
twoFactor.why: Signing in will ask for a code from an authenticator app on your phone as well as your password, so a stolen password is not enough.
twoFactor.scanTitle: Scan this with your authenticator app
twoFactor.scanHint: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or any TOTP app. Then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.typeInstead: Or type this key into the app:
twoFactor.codesHint: Keep these somewhere safe. Each lets you sign in once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
twoFactor.newCodesHint: Makes ten new codes; the old ones stop working.
twoFactor.staffKeep: Staff accounts keep two-factor sign-in on. If you lose your phone and your codes, another administrator can reset it.
twoFactor.banner: Your staff account needs two-factor sign-in before its staff pages open.
